description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the DataReaderV2 class, which reads media segment metadata from a buffer, parses it, and creates media segment objects for a media pipeline. It includes functions for converting metadata enums, creating media segments based on metadata, and reading multiple segments from a buffer.

classes.name: DataReaderV2
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and parsing media segment metadata from a buffer, creating media segment objects, and returning a vector of these segments.

methods.name: DataReaderV2
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DataReaderV2 with media source type, buffer, data offset, and number of frames.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads and parses media segment metadata from the buffer, creates media segments, and returns a vector of these segments.
